annotations.title: Repurpose a video for every placement

description: ONE video in, EVERY placement out, in one job, as a named file list (<name>_<placement>_<WxH>[_<lang>].mp4) with a manifest. Placements: 'everywhere' (default: 9:16, 4:5, 1:1, 16:9), any W:H, a pixel size (1200x628) or a platform word (tiktok, reels, stories, feed, square, youtube, linkedin, pinterest). Each is reframed by a BLUR-PAD by default (the whole frame over a blurred copy of itself; free, no AI), reframe 'crop' (fill, edges cut; free) or 'ai' (the new canvas generated around the frame; paid, for a canvas the engine makes, else padded and said). A placement may be {placement, reframe} to mix. Optional captions (word-timed, ~4 words a cue, placed for each canvas) and languages (a lip-synced dub per language; every placement of each). A pack of pads and crops only is billed 0. dryRun:true = the exact price (the sum of every leg's own price), which is what it charges. For ONE canvas use post_edit op pad.

captions.description: true = word-timed captions on every file (only when the user asks); a textStyle preset name or object sets the look

dryRun.description: price only: nothing made, nothing charged

languages.description: dub into these languages (paid), e.g. ['Spanish','de']; the original is kept too

name.description: the asset name the files are named after

pad.description: the pad's look: fill 'blur' (default) or a #rrggbb colour, blur 0-1, dim 0-0.6, position top/center/bottom or 0-1

placements.description: default ['everywhere']; a canvas, a WxH size, a platform word, or {placement, reframe}

reframe.description: default 'pad' (free); 'ai' is paid and only when the user asks

video.description: the video: an https / upload_file URL, a Library id (L0…), or a local path on the CLI

name: repurpose_video
title: Repurpose a video for every placement
